name: ClamAV
description: Open-source antivirus engine with daily signature updates, TCP interface for integration, and on-access scanning. Headless service.
compose:
services:
  clamav:
    image: clamav/clamav:latest
    environment:
      CLAMAV_NO_FTPD: "true"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.scan_dir}}:/scandir:ro
      - ./data:/var/lib/clamav
    restart: unless-stopped
